correctness.rationale: Exact enumerators generate all 5,281 and 18,721 nonempty independent sets. Explicit vertex-toggle face-poset matchings use 2,638 and 9,358 incidences; complete Hasse topological sorts verify acyclicity on all faces. Signed integral Morse-boundary recursion yields the zero 1-by-3 differential in each case. With one zero-cell, one 3/4-cell, three 4/5-cells and no others, degree-zero attachments are nullhomotopic, proving the stated sphere wedges. Independent integral unit chain cancellations recover the same free homology. Both executable checkers and outputs are included.
